item.title: Court declares oil firm unable to pay $15.3m debt, appoints administrator

item.title: AMNI clarifies legal position regarding reported Court order in Cenroc dispute
item.description: The order made by the Federal High Court does not appoint a Receiver-Manager over AMNI. Rather, the order, as drawn, relates to a limited appointment as Administrator for defined purposes connected to an alleged indebtedness.
